key_idea: Keep a stack of throw values; undo m pops m entries, and the answer is the stack sum mod n.
sketch: Read tokens; a number is pushed onto a stack, 'undo m' pops m entries (undos never undo undos, so a plain stack suffices). At the end sum the stack and reduce modulo n. O(k) time. Pitfall: throws can be negative, so normalise with ((s % n) + n) % n; parse 'undo' followed by a separate integer token.
